title: Tokker creator registry v1
description: The canonical creator list behind data/creators.json: one entry per AI lab/company, folding variant spellings (moonshot/moonshotai, zai/zhipu, alibaba/qwen) into aliases so every api_offers[].model_creator normalises to one id. See docs/SCHEMA.md.

id.description: Canonical creator id; the model_creator value on every offer of this creator.

name.description: Well-known display name of the company.

aliases.description: Other spellings of the same creator that must be folded into id.
